findings.description: `__aexit__` discards the active exception instead of forwarding it to `__exit__`, so failed async attempts are recorded as successful and their exceptions escape without retrying.
findings.rationale: When code inside `async with attempt:` raises a retryable exception, this call passes three `None` values to `__exit__`. The existing exit handler consequently records a successful `None` result and returns without suppressing the exception. The exception propagates out of the retry loop instead of triggering another attempt. Forward `exc_type`, `exc_value`, and `traceback` to preserve retry behavior.
